data.notes: July 2027 already has confirmed London stadium pop/Latin dates, a new Finsbury Park electronic festival, and a handful of open-air festival anchors, while most underground club calendars are not yet announced.

events.title: KAROL G — Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour
events.summary: KAROL G brings her Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour to Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, listed by the venue as the tour’s only UK stop.

events.title: Embrace LDN: Josh Baker b2b KETTAMA b2b Prospa
events.summary: New three-day Finsbury Park electronic festival headlined across the weekend by Josh Baker b2b KETTAMA b2b Prospa, with more acts to be announced.

events.title: Noah Kahan — The Last of the Bugs World Tour
events.summary: Noah Kahan brings The Last of the Bugs World Tour to Wembley Stadium for three confirmed London dates from 23 to 25 July.

events.title: Fontaines D.C. with Little Simz and Viagra Boys
events.summary: Fontaines D.C. play London Stadium on their 2027 outdoor run, with support from Little Simz and Viagra Boys confirmed by the stadium and Live Nation.

events.title: Slipknot — (sic)est Stadium Tour
events.summary: Slipknot’s Wembley Stadium date is billed as the band’s only UK and European performance of the tour, with Marilyn Manson, Lorna Shore and Hatebreed listed as guests on ticketing pages.

events.title: Don Omar — The Last King World Tour
events.summary: Reggaeton pioneer Don Omar plays The O2 as part of its 20th birthday series, billed as a greatest-hits live show.

events.title: Rock N Roll Circus London: Madness, Fat Freddy’s Drop, The Wailers and Hollie Cook
events.summary: Rock N Roll Circus’ inaugural London edition has confirmed Madness as the 24 July headliner, joined by Fat Freddy’s Drop, Big Special, The Wailers and Hollie Cook.

events.title: Alex Warren — Finding (More) Family On the Road
events.summary: Alex Warren brings his outdoor summer tour to Crystal Palace Park Live for two London headline dates on 3 and 4 July.

events.title: Jorja Smith — 10 Years of Jorja Smith: All the Hits
events.summary: Jorja Smith headlines The O2 for a 10-year hits show, confirmed by the venue as part of its 20th birthday line-up.

events.title: Kaleidoscope Festival
events.summary: Kaleidoscope Festival returns to Alexandra Palace Park on 10 July 2027; the venue notes that line-up announcements are still to come.

events.title: Frantic 30
events.summary: Landmark 30th-anniversary Frantic takeover of Studio 338, billed as a three-room mini-festival-style celebration and the venue’s first hard house and trance event.

events.title: Hayley Williams — The Hayley Williams Show 2027
events.summary: Hayley Williams plays two Alexandra Palace dates, billed as music from across her three solo albums plus special surprises.

events.title: Made In 90s Fest 2027
events.venueName: A Secret Location In South London
events.summary: Mature-audience 90s nostalgia festival/day party from the Made In 90s brand, centred on R&B, hip-hop, reggae, dancehall and old-school classics at a South London park location.

events.title: De Beauvoir Jazz Festival 2027
events.summary: Neighbourhood jazz festival across De Beauvoir Town, Hackney and Islington, presenting UK, international and local jazz artists in intimate venues, streets and public spaces.

events.title: Dance For Stevie Boat Party
events.summary: Summer Thames cruise fundraiser with Bobby & Steve and guests across two decks, focusing on soulful house plus classic soul, funk and boogie.

events.title: Evgeny Kissin in Recital
events.summary: Pianist Evgeny Kissin returns to the Barbican Hall for a solo recital on Thursday 1 July 2027 at 19:30.

events.title: BBC SO Total Immersion: The World of Tove Jansson
events.summary: Dalia Stasevska conducts the BBC Symphony Orchestra in the evening concert closing Barbican’s Total Immersion day devoted to Tove Jansson, with music inspired by her life and work.

events.title: Hamilton Loomis + guest acts
events.summary: Texas blues-rock guitarist and singer Hamilton Loomis plays the 100 Club on Tuesday 6 July 2027, presented by Solid Entertainments with guest acts to be announced.
